appearance_facts.fact: Y-axis scale: 0 to 24.0°C, with labeled tick marks at 0, 5, 10, 15, 20.
X-axis scale: 2005 to 2015, with labeled tick marks for each year.
Data line is a blue line connecting black circular data points.
Each data point is annotated with its exact temperature value in °C.
The line shows a consistent downward trend from 2005 to 2015.
